angle_conventions.domino_angles: Blender rotation_euler.y directly; geometry relative to forward bottom hinge
angle_conventions.gear2_angle: Mathematical XZ phase: Blender rotation_euler.y = -gear2_angle; add tooth phase in the same plane
angle_conventions.hammer_angle: Mathematical XZ direction from hammer pivot toward follower/head
angle_conventions.bell_swing: Positive swing moves bell right: Blender rotation_euler.y = -bell_swing
angle_conventions.flag_angle: Zero folded horizontally right, pi/2 upright; for a modeled vertical mast use rotation_euler.y = pi/2 - flag_angle

model.notes: Constrained reduced-order mechanics. One global slow-motion scale. No timed stage triggers.
